title: 색이 달라도 읽히는 화면: 추가 연결 해설

scenes.title: 윤곽에서 상태 변화로
lines: Outlines and patterns helped us read a static structure. When a platform changes height, we also need to understand the next movement. We will therefore watch height changes together with the character moving.

scenes.title: 경계에서 밝기 차이로
lines: Crossing the flowers required distinguishing platform tops and the destination ledge from the background. Even a retained shape can become difficult to follow when its boundary disappears into darkness. We will examine that problem through lightness differences.

scenes.title: 단서에서 실제 확인으로
lines: We have connected outlines, patterns, height, motion and lightness differences. To check whether those cues survive different colors, we need to examine conditions beyond the screen we normally see.
